{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pawalo District''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It included nondescript sections of urban sprawl and warehouses, and had at least [[Level 423|423 levels]]. The [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] [[Shell (slicer)|Shell]] and [[Deke (slicer)|Deke]] used a maintenance duct in a building in the Pawalo District to slice into a [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] database.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
